items.exampleEn: The hairdresser cut my hair too short.
items.exampleZh: 美髮師把我的頭髮剪得太短了。

items.exampleEn: Jade is a popular stone in Asia.
items.exampleZh: 玉在亞洲是很受歡迎的石頭。

items.exampleEn: Underpants are often sold in packs of three.
items.exampleZh: 內褲常常三件一組在賣。

items.exampleEn: This pullover keeps me warm on cold mornings.
items.exampleZh: 這件套頭毛衣讓我在冷冷的早上保持溫暖。

items.exampleEn: This tracksuit comes in five colors.
items.exampleZh: 這套運動服有五種顏色。

items.exampleEn: The hotel room has a hairdryer in the bathroom.
items.exampleZh: 飯店房間的浴室裡有吹風機。

items.exampleEn: A well-dressed man walked into the bank.
items.exampleZh: 一位穿著體面的男士走進銀行。

items.sentenceEn: This jade ring was a gift from my aunt.
items.sentenceZh: 這枚玉戒指是阿姨送我的禮物。

items.audioEn: Can I borrow your hairdryer? Mine stopped working this morning.
items.audioZh: 可以借我你的吹風機嗎？我的今天早上壞了。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要借吹風機？
options: The speaker's hair is too long
The speaker is going on a trip

items.sentenceEn: My uncle is always well-dressed, even at home.
items.sentenceZh: 我叔叔總是穿得很體面，連在家也是。

items.sentenceEn: He wore a tracksuit to the gym.

items.stemEn: Pack enough clean ____ for a week of travel.
items.stemZh: 打包足夠一週旅行用的乾淨內褲。

items.stemEn: For the job interview, you should look ____.
items.stemZh: 去工作面試，你應該穿得體面。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, my family went to my cousin's wedding. In the morning, my mother went to the hairdresser, and my father finally put away his old tracksuit and wore a suit. Everyone looked well-dressed. My grandmother wore her favorite jade necklace, which is more than fifty years old. I wore only a light pullover, so I felt slightly cold at night.
items.passageZh: 上星期天，我們全家去參加表親的婚禮。早上，媽媽去了美髮店，爸爸終於收起他那套舊運動服，穿上了西裝。大家都穿得很體面。奶奶戴著她最喜歡的玉項鍊，那條項鍊已經五十多年了。我只穿了一件薄的套頭毛衣，所以晚上覺得有點冷。

items.promptZh: 我把套頭毛衣忘在公車上了。
referenceEn: I left my pullover on the bus.
I forgot my pullover on the bus.
rubricZh: 說的是已經發生的事，可用過去式（例如 left、forgot）

items.promptZh: 我姊姊當美髮師已經五年了。
referenceEn: My sister has been a hairdresser for five years.
My older sister has worked as a hairdresser for five years.
rubricZh: 用 hairdresser 表示「美髮師」
表示持續到現在（例如 has been … for five years；寫 became a hairdresser five years ago 也正確）
